name: @tkliuxing/dsh-hypatia
description: DEPRECATED AND UNMAINTAINED - use dsh-hypatia-auto-memory instead. Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness backed by Hypatia: a host-side CLI adapter, a plugin-owned SQLite control ledger, same-request recall, and narrow memory tools. Requires the `hypatia` CLI on PATH.
deprecated: Deprecated and no longer maintained. Use dsh-hypatia-auto-memory instead: `dsh plugin --profile web remove @tkliuxing/dsh-hypatia`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hypatia-auto-memory`. Install one or the other, never both. See DEPRECATION.md.
